title: The eye trace is red in beat 4 and the shaded beat: the brightest region is not the emitter
text: Run on animatic 04's frames the eye-trace check reports 462 frames over 3 % of the width: 270 of the 300 frames of beat 4 (worst 30 %) and 192 of the shaded world's frames 1382-1619 (worst 67 %). In beat 4 at frame 630 the brightest unmasked region is at about (1109, 508), on Clawd, not the frame's glow at (1000, 140); the same check on the committed code's frames 700 and 780 (this run's 'before' stills, old keys and old blocking) read 19.7 % and 19.6 %, so it was red before the pose changed. The restaging helped elsewhere: arrival at frame 90 went from 2.5 % to 0.5 %, everything-at-once at 300 from 1.9 % to 0.4 %, cant-build at 525 from 3.8 % to 0.9 %, home-settle at 1700 from 5.0 % to 0.6 % and at 1800 from 4.0 % to 0.4 %, because the props no longer sit over the lit blocks. This is the question p007 asks (what the light pushes, per beat); the colour-continuity check fails on the same frames (630 drawn but unreadable).
before: eye-trace: 462 frames over 3 %, beat 4 and the shaded world
after: decided by p007: the target per beat
